hero.subtitle: 92° is the point where water pulls the bean's full flavor. We brew every cup at that precision — nothing left to chance.

journey.title: The road to 92°
journey.subtitle: Five stages, each at its own temperature. One degree off, and the taste changes.

stages.title: Bean
stages.desc: We source green beans from farmers and keep them cool to protect their flavor potential.

stages.title: Roast
stages.desc: Slow-roasted in small batches — unlocking sugars without burning the bean's structure.

stages.title: Grind
stages.desc: Freshly ground per drink — from espresso to pour-over, each with its own setting.

stages.title: Brew
stages.desc: Exactly 92° — the point where water extracts full flavor without bitterness.

stages.title: Serve
stages.desc: Served instantly, while the aroma peaks — from cup to you in seconds.

menu.title: What we brew
menu.subtitle: The full menu lives in the QR code on your table, or below. Here are the categories to get oriented.

categories.name: Espresso-based
categories.desc: Classics and signature twists — from ristretto to flat white.

categories.name: Alternative brew
categories.desc: Pour-over, dripper, aeropress — for those who notice nuance.

categories.name: Non-coffee
categories.desc: Matcha, cocoa, curated teas — warm and refreshing.
